text.text: And, behold, I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance, for their service which they serve, even the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.
And the Levite that is within thy gates; thou shalt not forsake him; for he hath no part nor inheritance with thee.
And as I may so say, Levi also, who receiveth tithes, payed tithes in Abraham.
